message.content: {"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo lists an \"Established credit relationship\" as a strength, which is contradicted by the background section that characterizes it as a \"relatively new credit relationship\" (originated just over one year prior to the memo date) whose early extension is a risk.", "The memo asserts \"Current compliance with all existing loan covenants\" as a credit positive, yet it also identifies \"Limited financial disclosure prevents assessment of underlying credit quality\" as a principal risk, which makes verifying compliance with financial covenants impossible."]}
